links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of NSQIP calculator on local IBD surgery patients
links.effect: c statistics 0.574-0.623 across outcomes (any complication 0.605, serious complication 0.623, anastomotic leakage 0.574); Brier scores 0.113-0.240; risks generally underestimated
links.quote: The accuracy of risks calculated by the ACS NSQIP Surgical Risk Calculator was deemed insufficient for patients undergoing surgery for IBD, generally underestimating postoperative risks.

links.outcome: Calibration of the calculator in the IBD surgical cohort, need for recalibration
links.effect: Modest calibration with systematic underestimation of postoperative risks; recalibration or additional variables suggested
links.quote: Recalibration or additional variables could be necessary to predict risks in this cohort.

screen.reason: The study conducts an independent external validation of an established clinical predictive risk calculator (ACS NSQIP Surgical Risk Calculator) in a specific target population (IBD surgery) to test calibration and discrimination before clinical reliance.
